*OVER 60 MILLION COPIES SOLD WORLDWIDE*

HARRY IS IN THE DARK

Harry is out of the police force. He has left a history of violence and grief behind him and is trying his hands at a new career. But when a woman is found murdered, her killing styled after a scene from a famous movie, and two more bodies turn up in rapid succession, newly minted homicide investigator Oleg Fauke turns to Harry for advice.

HE’S ABOUT TO GET PULLED INTO THE SPOTLIGHT

As gruesome films begin to appear and the victims pile up, Harry’s unique expertise is needed. He is drawn back into helping his old colleagues, and his personal relationships grow as complicated as the mind of the killer he is trying to catch.

WILL HE MAKE THE CUT?

'A 100% buy-today-read-tonight delight' LEE CHILD

'Nesbo deploys all the key ingredients of a cracking good thriller... effortless' Guardian

'The undisputed king of Scandinavian crime fiction' The Times

‘Unbearably tense’ Sunday Times
